observation_summary: A locale-dependent case conversion (str.toUpperCase()/searchStr.toUpperCase()) caused a failing locale-independence test (containsIgnoreCase). The fix replaces the toUpperCase-based comparison with an explicit loop using String.regionMatches(true, ...), changing how case-insensitive matching is performed.
reasoning_summary: The unified diff rewrites the core comparison algorithm: it removes the toUpperCase() approach and implements an explicit regionMatches-based scan. This is a procedural change to the method's computation (how case-insensitive containment is determined), which is an Algorithm/Method fix rather than a simple guard, value correction, interface change, or concurrency fix.
evidence_used: bug_report_description: notes that String.to*Case() is locale-sensitive and inappropriate for comparisons
buggy code (post-fix context): return contains(str.toUpperCase(), searchStr.toUpperCase());

fixed diff: replacement with loop using int len = searchStr.length(); int max = str.length() - len; for (int i=0; i<=max; i++) { if (str.regionMatches(true, i, searchStr, 0, len)) return true; } return false;
